title: Bowcaster
caption: Bowcaster (V)
game_text: Deploy on your Wookiee. May target a character or vehicle for free. Draw destiny (may take drawn card into hand). Target hit if destiny +X > defense value, where X = number of Kashyyyk sites you control.
lore: Hand-crafted weapon of choice among Wookiees. Fires explosive ‘quarrels’ (which look like blaster bolts). Requires great strength to use. Extra ammo carried on bandoliers.
copyright: TM & © 1996 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1996 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Group (sheet sub-heading): Battle Of Kashyyyk. Not unique (no dot in heading or caption; base is Unrestricted). Banner CHARACTER WEAPON; no stats/deploy/forfeit. Right margin: black EPISODE I disc above the VS16 set sphere → icons ['episode1'] (the printed ANH card has no Episode I icon). Slip text matches the stub. LORE CORRECTED from the 745 px scan: 'bandoleers' (wiki) → 'bandoliers' (printed); curly ‘quarrels’. Art: ANH-L-bowcaster.gif (745) is the PC ERRATA face (footer D-E1, errata game text) — art only; printed face = 12-ANH-L-bowcaster-decipher-archive.gif (350, read for lore/copyright; same lore). Modern: V16-L-bowcaster.gif (745, the PC's later modern Virtual Set 16 Bowcaster with different text; same art) and VB5-L-bowcaster-pre.gif (345 px, Virtual Block 5 reissue of THIS slip's text) — both in src/vs16/modern/. Copyright ANH 1996 (legible on the 745 scan).
